renters.description: My bicycle was stolen overnight from the locked bike room of the building. The lock was cut.

total_loss.description: Heavy rain flooded James Street where the car was parked. Water came up over the seats.

open_at_clock.description: A deer ran onto the road near Albany at dusk and hit the front of the car.

disputed_repair.description: A pan caught fire on the stove. The fire was put out, but smoke filled the kitchen and the living room.
